reels.caption:
Hotel room layouts rethink! 😌 📏✏️

The same layout everywhere you go and it has wasted space.

When we designed a 10B holiday lodge we made sure to fix this turning the en-suites and showers 90deg. By walking into the shower at the short end, there is no need for screens. This means hours of time saved for the housekeeping team and less maintenance. The ugly sealant gunk gone!

Without the "hallway" in the bedroom there is more space for the bed so we could use emperors as a USP without adding costly square metres to the build.

#interiorarchitecture #hospitalitydesign #hoteldesign #layout #architect
